model_explanation: with recipient focus (ELLEN), “only” means no one other than Ellen got grapes; thus Tom didn’t get grapes.
with object focus (APPLES), “only” means Ellen got nothing but apples; hence she didn’t get oranges.
with object focus (GRAPES), “only” limits what Rob got (just grapes), not who else got grapes; Ellen may also have gotten grapes.
with object focus (APPLES), “only” limits what Rob got, not who else got apples; giving Ellen apples is compatible but not entailed.
